guards: Callers pass an opaque provider_result_ref, not a raw host result mapping.
The default AW CLI fails closed unless a protected host/provider resolver supplies the provider result and admission verdict.
Host admission verdict, capability revision/status, result digest, supersession, and revocation are re-resolved immediately before import.
Result and admission file/index writes are append-preserving, locally locked, idempotent, and rolled back together on partial failure.
Adapter receipt recording consumes only imported host_result_ref values.
